title: Plant a Pet Seed
source: Grow a Garden seed loop + companion-planting / cross-pollination
loop: Buy cheap seed packets, plant them in plot rows, water, wait real minutes/hours; pull the sprout when its ears show; sell or keep; visit neighbours' plots to see what is growing next to your fence
twist: Species is not in the packet: it is decided by what grows in the ADJACENT tiles, including the tiles across a neighbour's fence. Cross-pollination between two players' plots makes hybrids neither could grow alone, so fence-line planting is a negotiation (or a griefing tool: plant weeds next to their rare row)
pet_role: The pet is the crop: it grows rooted, then uproots itself and follows you; pulled too early it stays a runt, left too long it wanders off to whichever neighbour watered it most
money: Sprinkler (fires when a row dries while offline); Pollen Puff (fires when you see a neighbour's rare row next to your fence); Root Anchor (fires when a ripe pet starts wandering)
